transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Well... I guess I'm just having a hard time sitting still. Like when I'm supposed to be sitting in a staff meeting at work, or... church briefings. 

I just get this feeling like there's a motor humming under my skin. I usually end up shifting around a lot, or... I just find some excuse to stand up and move. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you recently started taking any new medications, or changed the dose of any medication?
No... no new medications. I haven't changed anything.
Did you experience this kind of restlessness or difficulty sitting still when you were a child?

Yeah... I suppose so. I remember getting in trouble back in grade school for it. Just... popping out of my seat, mostly. Or talking over the teacher. I'd usually rush ahead before they even finished giving directions. My mother... she used to say I acted like I was wound too tight. Even as a kid. So... yeah.
Besides the physical restlessness, do you also struggle with paying attention or staying focused on tasks?
No... I don't think so. I mean, my work keeps me on my feet mostly. I just clean the building and get it done. I haven't really noticed any problems with paying attention... just the other stuff.
